title: Velocity expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct final expression for velocity: v = 2(2-√3)qdB/m.

title: Length expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct final expression for the hit region length: L = 2(2-√3)d.

title: Lorentz force application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply qvB = mv²/r to relate velocity, magnetic field, and orbit radius.

title: Critical orbit geometry
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must establish the geometric condition r + r sin60° = d for the particle that first hits the moving plate.

title: Impact range geometry
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly determine the minimum (x_min = r) and maximum (x_max = 2r) impact distances from point P on the screen.

title: Correct trigonometric value
description: Important Criteria: The calculation must correctly use sin60° = √3/2 and simplify the resulting expressions.

title: Direction of force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly determines the direction of the Lorentz force for a negative charge, leading to wrong curvature.

title: Geometric misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student misinterprets the r + r sin60° = d condition or the x_min/x_max relationships from the circular orbits.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may include a verification that the final expressions have correct physical dimensions.
